title: Vera adds a new section in the website editor, only of a kind the Add tab offers on that page, with the block's own placeholder prompts, on the draft

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (Vera makes the changes the user directs, inside the editor, confirm before write) and 20:39Z (I approve everything, get this done); Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V2 structure verbs (insert empty). Builds on LIVE-2097, LIVE-2098 and LIVE-2110.

detail:
Vera could rearrange, hide, duplicate and restyle sections but not add one, so "add a gallery after the hero" came back empty. Add an add kind: the editor sends the sections the Add tab offers on the page in view (a block at its per-page cap is left out) on the menu it already sends, the server reads that list by shape and refuses a malformed one, and only a type on it at a position the page has becomes a tickable line. Apply inserts the block exactly as the Add tab does (its defaultProps prompts and a fresh id, refused at its cap) in the same one-undo-step commit as the other lines. Vera writes no words: the line says the section arrives with placeholder text for the owner's words.

Shipped: the add kind in vera-layout.ts, the section list on the Vera menu, tests and probe.
